mapper.select: SELECT b.REFORM_SCHEME, b.MEMO FROM `inspection`.`inspection_reform_ledger` a JOIN `inspection`.`inspection_reform_scheme` b ON a.`ID` = b.`REFORM_ID` WHERE a.`LEDGER_ID` = #{params.LEDGER_ID} AND a.`TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} ORDER BY b.`SCHEME_TIME` DESC LIMIT 0, 1

SELECT a.id, a.CONTENT_DSCR, a.CONTENT_PID, a.SORT FROM
inspection.`inspection_content` a
inspection.`inspection_content_regbook` a
WHERE
a.`TYPE_CODE` = #{params.TYPE_CODE}
a.`BOOK_ID` = #{params.BOOK_ID}
AND (a.`CONTENT_PID` = '' OR a.`CONTENT_PID` IS NULL)
SELECT * FROM `dmcode`.`cm_guoku_dimnsn` cd WHERE cd.`guoku_id` = ( SELECT a.`INSPECTED_GUOKU_ID` FROM `inspection`.`inspection_task` a WHERE a.`INSPECTION_TASK_ID` = #{params.TASK_ID} )
